text.en:
Executive Order No. 460 dated September 2, 2005 is
hereby repealed. The provisions of Executive Order No. 119 dated August 28,
2002 which were earlier amended by Executive Order No. 460 are thus hereby
reinstated.

All orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts
thereof inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or modified
accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take eflect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 9th day of May, in the year of
Our Lord, Two Thousand and Seven.
glenn the Array
By the President:
EDUARDO R. ERMITA
Executive Secretary
